To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Coherent light can cool a beam and a beam can cool light”.

the coherent state of a system can be defined in terms of its quantum information and energy content, that the quantum information and energy can be transferred from a system to another via a process of “quantum information and energy transfer”, and that this transfer can be achieved in the absence of any classical interaction between the two systems, and in a time much shorter than the characteristic time of the system.

the interaction of light and particle beams can be understood in the language of coherent states and that the interaction can be used to generate and manipulate coherent states of matter (particles) and radiation (photons) in a variety of configurations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction of charged particle beams with electromagnetic fields of various types, ranging from the classical to the quantum, in various configurations.
the interaction of light with matter, with a particular focus on ultrafast processes.
the interaction of light with charged particle beams and the generation of particle and photon beams via optical techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the theme of “Alight a beam, beaming light” is a very rich one and that it has many variations and many applications.
“coherence is a state of mind.”

coherent states of matter (and radiation) and their interactions with each other and the environment (incoherent radiation) are at the heart of many of the most challenging problems in modern science.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are in a position to generate and manipulate coherent states of matter (particles) and radiation (photons) with unprecedented control and precision.
“light is the ultimate probe and the ultimate tool”.
we are exploring a few aspects of a theme with variations, with a few applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the coherent states of radiation and matter are the most efficient and effective means of energy exchange, information transfer and processing.

a coherent beam of particles or photons can be generated from an incoherently prepared beam by a process of “slicing” the incoherent beam in space and time, and the resulting coherent beam can then be used to produce a coherent beam of photons via Thomson/Compton backscattering.

coherent states of matter, radiation or their combinations are a rich and versatile resource, and can be used to generate, manipulate and control other states, as well as to extract information from them.
